images.filename: The Illustrated London News Volume XLVIII News 16 June 1866 p 5 'Hampton Races - the ferry at Molesey'.png
images.caption:
Engraving of the Hampton Races, the Ferry at Moulsey. Illustration for The Illustrated London News, 16 June 1866, showing the ferry from Hampton to Molesey, with St Mary's Church, Garrick's Villa and Garrick's Temple, Hampton all in the background. Horse races were held at Hurst Park, Molesey, accessible by the ferry from Hampton.
The Hampton ferry has been operating since 1514 to the present day.
images.alt:
Engraving of the Hampton Races, the Ferry at Moulsey. Illustration for The Illustrated London News, 16 June 1866, showing the ferry from Hampton to Molesey, with St Mary's Church, Garrick's Villa and Garrick's Temple, Hampton all in the background. Horse races were held at Hurst Park, Molesey, accessible by the ferry from Hampton.
The Hampton ferry has been operating since 1514 to the present day.
